title: reframe
description: Crop path for a moving reframe of one clip, written by scripts/reframe.py: the crop window position over time so a 16:9 source can be cut to any aspect (9:16 default) while the subject stays in frame. x and y are the crop window's top-left corner in source pixels, clamped so the window stays inside the frame. Points are smoothed (no jumps, limited speed); source says what placed the window at that sample.

t_s.description: sample time inside the source clip, seconds

x.description: crop window left edge in source pixels

y.description: crop window top edge in source pixels

source.description: what placed the window: face = YuNet detection, track = tracker between detections, saliency = no-face fallback, hold = kept the last good centre

confidence.description: confidence of the placement: detection score, tracker score, saliency peak strength, or the held confidence decaying

path.description: absolute path of the source clip (read-only)

start_s.description: start of the analysed range inside the clip

end_s.description: end of the analysed range inside the clip

aspect.description: target aspect ratio as W:H, e.g. 9:16

crop_w.description: crop window width in source pixels (even)

crop_h.description: crop window height in source pixels (even)

tracker.description: tracker used between detections, e.g. mil

points.description: crop window positions in time order, one per sample

warnings.description: non-fatal problems: missing model, unreadable samples, held windows

wall_time_s.description: wall time of the run in seconds

cost_usd.description: LLM cost of the run in USD (always 0: reframe makes no model calls)
